title: Sharp Bounds and Extremal Fuzzy Graphs for the Fuzzy Sombor Index
summary: The fuzzy Sombor index applies the classical Sombor index to fuzzy graphs, incorporating both edge membership values and fuzzy vertex degrees. For $α>1$, the general fuzzy Sombor index it is defined as \[ \mathrm{SO}^μ_α(Γ)=\sum_{uv\in V(Γ)} \left( μ(u,v)\, \sqrt{μ_u^2+μ_v^2} \right)^α. \] This paper analyses extremal features of $\mathrm{SO}^μ$ across different types of fuzzy graphs. We determine the maximum value (resp. minimum value) of $\mathrm{SO}^μ$ characterise in regular fuzzy graph.
